I will
deck thee with trophies, garlands of my defeat. It is never in my power to escape unconquered.

paragraphs.source_en: I surely know my pride will go to the wall, my life will burst its bonds in exceeding pain, and my empty heart will sob out in music like a hollow reed, and the stone will melt in tears.

paragraphs.source_en: From the blue sky an eye shall gaze upon me and summon me in silence. Nothing will be left for me, nothing whatever, and utter death shall I receive at thy feet.
